notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
Minor patch to resolve some instances where if you preformed an action on the same frame you stopped recording, that action would not be captured.

Resolved an issue where, mostly in Sealords, the pre-record that spawns on the box would be thrown off on playback start.

notes.title: Gameplay Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

This is the largest update so far which brings new recording and playback code which either fully resolves or heavily reduces playback "desyncs" that would happen depending on various conditions during gameplay. 

Changes included in this update


New recording and playback code

    Resolved issue where a ghost was mid-air a desync was likely to occur
    Resolved issue where a ghost would not jump if you jumped on the same frame a recording was started
    Resolved issue where a ghost that was started on the edge of it's collider was likely to desync
    Resolved issue where a ghost would desync if you stationary jumped and started moving mid air
    Heavily improved issue where a ghost would not maintain its relative position to the cube that it was started on, leading to desyncs

Resolved issue where standing on a held cube, while holding another cube may result in the boxes fighting for a resting position.
Resolved issue where "Last Run" on clipboard did not show times over 1 hour properly
Reduced (or maybe even eliminated) the loading screen becoming stuck forever after returning to the main menu and then loading another level
Reduced chance that box riding a pulsed box in Market time would put you out of bounds
Fixed fizzler on Dragon Fire not working properly


If you find any more bugs, please let us know at our Discord!

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Small bug fixes and improvements out now!

Main Menu music now loops
Left Shift + Left Control + Restart Key now restarts your run fully from Sunrise
FOV slider in main menu no longer freaks out
Fixed fizzler in Ranch Hand
Added the graph

notes.title: July 28th Update
notes.content:
Another update with some fixes and changes!

    Achievement and Leader board code refactored by Jim.
            This should resolve issues with the clipboard displaying the wrong time.
            No Death runs should be fixed as well
        
    Resolved some edge cases where boxes would lose collisions when held against walls in certain ways
    Resolved issue where you could launched yourself OOB when box riding a pulse.
    In speed runner mode, the level list is sorted with Sunrise first to make full game restarts faster.
    Fixed issue where you could not return to main menu in levels after Tailwind in speed runner mode

notes.title: Quality of Life and Speed Running
notes.content:
This is the 3rd patch issued so far. There are still a few bugs / issues, but we're working to improve the game into the state we want it to be in. Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs so far!


Implemented "Speed Runner" mode that will skip most cutscenes, all tutorials, an drastically decrease the time spent in the exit sequence. You can find it under the "Input" options menu.
Added a "Restart Level" key action to instantly restart the current level. Default is "Backspace"
Fixed edge case where starting playback too soon may break the game until you restart.
When Speed Runner mode is enabled, the current level time and full run time (If you start on Sunrise) will display in the top right.
Added FOV Slider. Default is 60.
Adder VHS Post Processing Effect Intensity Slider. Default is 100.
Refactored Ingame timer code
Updated AutoSplitter data objects to use more accurate times
Few smaller bug fixes

notes.title: 2nd Post Launch Update!
notes.content:
Fixed keybinds resetting on level change
Fixed grab buffering issue so grabbing cubes, mostly in Attleboro, feels much better
Modifier keys don't count to load the next level
Fixed issue where recording eraser would sometimes erase the wrong recording
Fixed issue where hologram tether PFX would sometimes have the wrong color
Fixed issue where ghosts could sometimes block the entire scene
Fixed issue where you could create a new recording starting in another recording's hologram
You can now pause in the exit sequence to allow for restarts of levels without returning to the main menu
You can skip main menu animations / cut scenes with Escape
Added support for AutoSplitter
Update credits
Added Discord Join button to main menu
Added leaderboard link to main menu
Updated Dewey Canyon visuals to lead the player more
Fixed model clipping issue on Enhance Plus
Fixed invalid light probes on Baby Lift
Fixed clipping on Deckhouse Five
Fixed exploit on Dragon Fire
Adjusted collisions on laser grids

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
First game, first patch!

Adjusted cube collision handling when cubes are inside the player. This should prevent the cubes from forcing the player though the walls/floor.

Other minor null ref fixes.
